title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best gym in Auckland with our comprehensive guide, featuring prices, contract terms and franchise locations.
intro: Aucklanders have a wide range of gym options to choose from, with prices starting from $12.99 per week. With so many options, it can be difficult to decide which gym is best for you. In this guide, we'll help you compare prices and find the best gym in your area.

sections.heading: Gym Options by Suburb
sections.body: Auckland has a number of gyms located throughout the city, with popular suburbs including the CBD, Ponsonby, and Newmarket. Some of the most popular gyms in Auckland include Anytime Fitness, Jetts, and City Fitness.

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms
sections.body: If you're looking for a gym that's convenient to get to on your way to or from work, there are a number of options in the Auckland CBD. The Auckland CBD is home to a number of gyms, including City Fitness, Les Mills, and Anytime Fitness.

sections.heading: Parking and Accessibility
sections.body: If you're looking for a gym with easy parking, you may want to consider a gym located in a suburban area. Some gyms, such as Jetts, offer free parking for members. Others, such as City Fitness, are located in areas with limited parking options.
